Name: Kitty Channels 1.6 - MOVED TO THE MAIN MOD (KITTY CHANNELS)
Author: sashaldystauns
Description:
[quote][size=3]﻿[/size][size=5]After receiving permission from Maraluna7, the fix mod has been merged into the main mod,[size=3] [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9387]Kitty Channels[/url]. You no longer need to download two separate mods. Please visit the main mod,[size=3] [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9387]Kitty Channels[/url], from now on. All compatibility files have been moved there as well.

I'm so sorry for all the inconvenience🙇🏻‍♀️[/size][/quote]

[size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/5ZdBQv6.png[/img][/size]
[size=3]Feeling a bit strange seeing the human version of the weather report during the green rains event? Or do you want to see the new background for the fortune teller in the kitty version? Look no further! With this 1.6 fix, you can enjoy our adorable kitties from [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9387]Kitty Channels[/url][size=3]. See the image below (it's contained spoiler!)[/size]
[size=3][spoiler][img]https://i.imgur.com/oAX8HoD.jpeg[/img][/spoiler][/size]

[size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/HudgTlZ.png[/img][/size]
[size=3]This is a very simple mod, so there will be no config options available.[/size]

[size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/Q4o3aNa.png[/img][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Make sure you've got the latest [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ installed. [/size]
[*][size=3]Since I've added [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9387]Kitty Channels[/url]﻿ as the required dependency, make sure you have that installed too. [/size]
[*][size=3]Download and unzip this mod into your mods folder. [/size]
[*][size=3]Start the game with this mod installed. [/size]
[*][size=3]Now, dive back into the world of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9387]Kitty Channels[/url]﻿ without missing a single meow![/size]
[/list][size=3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/DpQRWUi.png[/img]
[list]
[*][size=3]This is a very simple mod, as long as your other mods doesn’t make any changes to the TV Channels, this mod will be completely fine. [/size]
[*][size=3]If you're using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetics[/url]﻿ mod, make sure to download both the main file and the optional file.[/size]
[*][size=3]If you're using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20684]Natural Dark Wood Interface[/url]﻿ mod, make sure to download the optional file ONLY.[/size]
[*][size=3]Because the new update of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded﻿[/url], please make sure to download both the main file and the optional file.[/size]
[*][size=3]The latest update from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6166]Overgrown Flowery Interface[/url]﻿ has removed the included Kitty Channels feature, So, you'll need to download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9387]Kitty Channels[/url]﻿ and this mod instead.[/size]
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/IRcHegE.png[/img]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]If your other mods make changes to the TV channels, you can look at the solutions below.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Gm0xiBI.png[/img]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Check if the conflicting mod has a toggle to disable TV channels changes and deactivate it.[/size]
[*][size=3]If the mod doesn't have a toggle, you can manually remove the TV channels' part from its content.json file. This only works if that mod makes specific changes, not replace the whole tile sheet.[/size]
[*][size=3]Alternatively, you can replace the conflicting asset with the one provided by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9387]Kitty Channels[/url]﻿ and this fix.[/size]
[*][size=3]If you're unsure how to remove the TV channels' part from your other mods or if you're concerned it might not work. Or if another problem happens to you, just let me know in the comments, and I'll make sure to help you out. ^^[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/F32EG1g.png[/img]
1.0.0 - Initial release of this mod.

[/size][quote][size=3][b]Credits:[/b]
﻿Special thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/83494008]Maraluna7[/url]﻿ for creating [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9387]Kitty Channels[/url]﻿ and granting permission for this fix. Please show your support by endorsing her mods, and also kindly considering giving this fix mod an endorsement. <3[/size][/quote][size=3]
Hey there, I'm Sashaldystauns.
I'm newbie modder and excited to share my second mod with you! If you run into any problems, I apologize in advance. I'm still learning, so your support and feedback are greatly appreciated! ^^

P.S. English isn't my first language, but hopefully, you'll still be able to understand what I've written here (I'm using a translator app).[/size]
